Pose - Weapon Drawn.name: Pose - Weapon Drawn
Pose - Weapon Drawn.description:
🕴️ Pose: Weapon Drawn
Standing with a weapon visibly held and ready — blade, firearm, or tool in hand, prepared for action.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Weapon Drawn.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, use a guarded ready posture with shoulders squared toward the threat line and weight slightly forward. Show a weapon only when another selected visual trait explicitly defines that visible weapon; otherwise keep both hands empty in a defensive guard. Female: shoulders angled rather than squared, guard held close to the body. Male: shoulders squared into the line, guard held out. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own ready stance.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
